# FLX-6202: a FLUX setting names a column for a rule that cannot generate it

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

The `generates` setting of a contract rule (extensions["com.agentics.flux/1"].emits[&lt;exposeId&gt;].invariants.&lt;id&gt;) names the column that a `check` of bounds or difference form generates. It is refused on a rule that is not a `check`, on a `check` of any other form, and when it names a column that the value side or the `when` reads.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6202
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
